kerbWeight.sourceNote: Published as a 1,410-1,521 kg range across the model line-up; the lowest figure in the range is recorded here at generation level, not assigned to any one trim.

power.sourceNote: Wikipedia's article on the production car (marked by its own editors as needing an update) gives a motor output only for the 2022 4Ever Trophy show car (100 kW, described there as 'expected'), not a confirmed figure for any production trim. Euro NCAP separately names a production trim 'EV52 Techno', implying at least one battery size, but without a power figure attached. Using the concept figure for the production car would misattribute a different vehicle's number.

batteryCapacity.sourceNote: Only a concept-car battery figure (42 kWh, for the 2022 4Ever Trophy show car) is given in the source; no production battery capacity is stated, though Euro NCAP's naming of an 'EV52' trim implies one exists.
